text: My boys will be with them presently. I wish we had some sort of description of those rascals—’twould help a good deal. But you couldn’t see what they were like, in the dark, lad, I suppose?” “Oh yes; I saw them downtown and follered them.” “Splendid! Describe them—describe them, my boy!” “One’s the old deaf and dumb Spaniard that’s ben around here once or twice, and t’other’s a mean-looking, ragged—” “That’s enough, lad, we know the men! Happened on them in the woods back of the widow’s one day, and they slunk away.
